Debt entries need a debtDate (YYYY-MM-DD); a guard fails once a debt entry is more than 30 days past its date. openOwnerDecisions.note: G4 bans Latin-script terms only. hi.ts and ur.ts use लग्न / لگن (lagna) as the Ascendant label and ग्रह as the ordinary Hindi word for planet. Whether native-script equivalents are banned is undecided; they are not scanned.

CLAUDE.md says exactly 5 Ruling Planets with horaLord as an extended witness only. docs/RKP_RULES_FROM_SARFARAZ.md §4 lists 5 + Hora Lord as a 6th confirmatory lord, and getRulingPlanets returns a 6-tuple including horaLord. allWitnesses does not exist. shamsi_method.txt is not in the repo. G5 is an it.todo until the owner decides.

bannedUserFacingTerms.$comment: G4 (OD-2): Latin-script terms only, never native-script Hindi/Urdu (see OD-2-native-script). RKP and KP are case-sensitive acronyms so lowercase ids such as "rkp-card" are not treated as copy; the rest are case-insensitive. Shared by both guard suites.
